description: Curated tactical world encounter spawn points across the Lands Between for hostile NPC enemies and invaders.

encounters.landmark: Outside the tutorial cave exit doors overlooking Limgrave
encounters.description: Crossbreed Priscilla standing in the windswept grass right outside the wooden exit doors of the Stranded Graveyard.

encounters.name: Stormhill Crossroads
encounters.landmark: Warmaster's Shack / Stormhill Gate
encounters.description: Wandering duelist patrol pacing the stormy windswept crossroads near Bernahl's shack.
